name: no-raw-string-ids
description: Disallow an un-branded string literal where a branded ID (RunId/NodeId/DagId) is expected. A literal followed by `as RunId` is branded on purpose and is not reported; one assigned straight into an ID field is the argument-swap bug the brand exists to catch. Scoped to the library and the demo app: operator scripts and fixtures pass raw strings by design.
fixHint: Use the smart constructor: runId('...'), nodeId('...'), or dagId('...') to produce branded IDs. Raw strings do not satisfy the brand at compile time.
